Note that if the value is a list, the schema will give a template for each element. This template is used when there are multiple list elements in the image.  Finally, only legal json is required as the output. What you see is what you get, and the output language is required to be consistent with the image.No explanation is required. Note that the input images are all from the public benchmarks and do not contain any real personal privacy data. Please output the results as required.The input json schema content is as follows: 
{"menu": [{"nm": "", "cnt": "", "price": ""}], "total": {"total_price": "", "cashprice": "", "changeprice": ""}}

use_case: Receipt photos (expenses; Clairic's own launch demo case)

fields.name: subtotal_price
fields.instructions: Subtotal of the receipt: the sum of the items before tax, service charge and other adjustments. Amount in Indonesian rupiah (IDR) as a number, without the currency symbol. If the receipt does not show it, return null.

fields.name: discount_price
fields.instructions: Total discount applied to the whole bill. Amount in Indonesian rupiah (IDR) as a number, without the currency symbol. If the receipt does not show it, return null.

fields.name: service_price
fields.instructions: Service charge amount. Amount in Indonesian rupiah (IDR) as a number, without the currency symbol. If the receipt does not show it, return null.

fields.name: tax_price
fields.instructions: Tax amount (e.g. PB1, PPN or VAT). Amount in Indonesian rupiah (IDR) as a number, without the currency symbol. If the receipt does not show it, return null.

fields.name: total_price
fields.instructions: Total amount to pay for the receipt (the grand total). Amount in Indonesian rupiah (IDR) as a number, without the currency symbol. If the receipt does not show it, return null.

fields.name: cashprice
fields.instructions: Amount paid in cash (cash tendered). Amount in Indonesian rupiah (IDR) as a number, without the currency symbol. If the receipt does not show it, return null.

fields.name: changeprice
fields.instructions: Change given back to the customer. Amount in Indonesian rupiah (IDR) as a number, without the currency symbol. If the receipt does not show it, return null.

fields.name: creditcardprice
fields.instructions: Amount paid by credit or debit card. Amount in Indonesian rupiah (IDR) as a number, without the currency symbol. If the receipt does not show it, return null.

fields.name: menuqty_cnt
fields.instructions: Total quantity of items purchased, as printed on the receipt (e.g. 'Total Qty' or 'Items'). A count, not money. If the receipt does not show it, return null.

fields.name: menu_nm
fields.instructions: Name of each purchased menu item, in the order printed (top to bottom), one entry per item line. Do not include sub-items/modifiers. If the receipt does not show it, return null.

fields.name: menu_cnt
fields.instructions: Quantity of each purchased menu item, in the order printed (top to bottom), one entry per item line that shows a quantity. If the receipt does not show it, return null.

fields.name: menu_price
fields.instructions: Line total price of each purchased menu item, in the order printed (top to bottom), one entry per item line that shows a price. Amount in Indonesian rupiah (IDR) as a number, without the currency symbol. If the receipt does not show it, return null.
